Spending rule for the bistro: any supplier order over £400 must have sign-off from our finance lead Priya Nair before it goes out. Orders of £400 or less can be placed straight away.
Confirming our autumn pricing for The Copper Kettle: farmhouse cheddar is £8.50 per kg, and we deliver to your kitchen on Tuesdays and Fridays.
Our house red stays at £13 a bottle for you, sold in cases of 12. We can deliver to the bistro any weekday before noon.
Walk-in fridge can hold at most 60 kg of cheese at a time, so weekly restocks must stay modest.

Placed the October cheddar order with Hartley Dairy: 40 kg at £8.50 per kg, £340 in total, delivery to the kitchen on Friday 23 October. At £340 it sits under the £400 sign-off line, so it went out confirmed without needing Priya Nair's approval.
Ordered 20 bottles of the house red from Halloway Vintners at £13 a bottle, £260 in total. Well under the £400 sign-off line, so it went straight out confirmed for delivery before noon on a weekday.

Set up a standing weekly cheddar restock with Hartley Dairy, about 38 kg a week at roughly £320, delivered each Friday to the kitchen. Since £320 is under the £400 sign-off line, the standing order runs with no approval required from Priya Nair.

Scheduled the autumn menu briefing for the kitchen team on Friday 30 October in The Copper Kettle kitchen, once the cheddar restock arrangement with Hartley Dairy was settled with no approval needed on the weekly order.
Confirmed the private anniversary dinner for Rosa Delgado, 14 guests in the dining room on Saturday 14 November, deposit paid. Any move of the date would need Rosa's agreement under house rules.
Ordered 10 bags of strong bread flour from Millfield Mills, £150 in total, confirmed for delivery to the kitchen next week.
Remember to pay the Halloway Vintners September invoice by 15 October.
Autumn delivery days are holding steady: Tuesdays and Fridays as usual. Let me know if you want the cheddar volume adjusted before Christmas.

Team, after last week's stock-count discrepancy I am tightening our spending rule: from today, any supplier order over £300 needs Priya Nair's sign-off before it goes out. The old £400 line no longer applies, so please treat £300 as the threshold for anything new or still open.
We've just landed a lovely blue cheese at £9 per kg. A 40 kg wheel order for The Copper Kettle would come to £360 if you fancy it for the cheese board.
Front-of-house rota for the last week of October is drafted; two evening shifts still need cover.
Your September flour delivery went out fine on our side. Same delivery day next month unless we hear otherwise.
Notes from the floor-staff catch-up: coat hooks by the door need replacing, and the Sunday lunch quiz night idea got a warm response.
A heads-up that our office closes for the first week of November, so any early-November wine orders should reach us by 28 October.
